findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-baseline-smoke.ts claims stale-artifact coverage but never seeds a stale final-report or stale lower-layer suite report. The only negative suite case at lines 443-469 covers malformed JSON, mixed-schema, and authority-overclaim; the claim cases at lines 471-513 cover missing lower layers and sequential unlock only. CHK-001/002/003/005/006 verificationEvidence says smoke verified stale rejection, but this required fail-closed path is untested and the recorded evidence overstates coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6d1fcae6: lattice-baseline-smoke now seeds real stale final-report and stale lower-layer suite cases, plus invalid status/local-stub/fresh-authorized lower-layer claim coverage. Verified on current story branch with npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke, npm test, and lattice validate allPass=true.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1171-1232 and 1277-1279 promote purely local baseline_run stub artifacts into engineering suiteStatus=PASS/authorization=authorized as soon as a development suite file exists. Repro: seed a PASS development baseline-suite-report.json, run baseline_run for each ENG-* id, then run node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering --format=json; it returns PASS/authorized with no real engineering proof. That violates the documented boundary that Parallel Development is implementation-only and claim/proof unlock stays sequential (Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:28-31, 82-84), and Engineering suite PASS requires real runs plus maturity/rate checks (Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md:421-469), not local harness presence.

packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1335 capability_claim_evaluate never authorizes an evidence-backed lower-layer claim. Even with seeded PASS suite reports for development+engineering, the command still returns authorized=false and authorizedClaimLevel=none while reporting highestEvidenceBackedClaim=engineering, so CHK-005 happy/edge behavior cannot succeed. Fix by deriving authorization/authorizedClaimLevel from the strongest satisfied lower-layer proof instead of hard-coding a permanent block for all targets.

packages/main/src/core/lattice-baseline.ts:1045 parseFinalReport accepts any non-empty status string, so malformed final-report artifacts are not rejected. I seeded a full engineering layer where ENG-BUGFIX-1 used status="totally-wrong"; baseline_suite_report still returned suiteStatus=PASS and marked that artifact accepted. Fix by validating status against pass|blocked|failed|not_authorized before accepting the report, and refuse malformed status values fail-closed.
